messages.en:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook's{ff 00 00 00} shop is pretty{01 00 00 0a 00}
cool,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}. {01 00 00 0a 00}It's a
pretty chill place.
{07 00 00}Only, {ff 00 00 06}Tom{ff 00 00 00} is kinda intense.
He talks all fast and loud,
like, {07 06 00}"Hm? Yes, yes, yes!"
{07 00 00}Sometimes, I just want him
to chill a little.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 08 00}He totally
harshes my mellow!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nooki{ff 00 00 00} pood on päris{01 00 00 0a 00}
lahe,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}. {01 00 00 0a 00}Üsna
rahulik koht.
{07 00 00}Ainult et {ff 00 00 06}Tom{ff 00 00 00} on pisut äge.
Räägib kiiresti ja valjult,
nagu {07 06 00}„Hm? Jah, jah, jah!"
{07 00 00}Vahel tahaks, et ta pisut
rahuneks.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 08 00}Ta rikub mu
rahu täiesti!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Um,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00} just
looking grown up{01 00 00 05 00} doesn't
make something grown up.
{07 15 00}No matter how grown up
your place looks,{01 00 00 05 00} if you
don't act it,{01 00 00 0a 00} you aren't!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ee,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00} ainult
täiskasvanu moodi välimus{01 00 00 05 00}
ei tee asja täiskasvanuks.
{07 15 00}Ükskõik kui täiskasvanulik
su kodu välja näeb,{01 00 00 05 00} kui sa
ise nii ei käitu,{01 00 00 0a 00} siis pole!

messages.en:
{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00} sure is working
hard,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

{07 19 00}Yep. Changing your stock
daily is tough work{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} There
is no way I could do it.{07 00 00}
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I could probably add new
snacks everyday. But that's
about it, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00} töötab küll
kõvasti,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

{07 19 00}Jah. Kaupa iga päev muuta
on raske töö{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Mina
seda küll ei suudaks.{07 00 00}
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Küll suudaksin iga päev
uusi näkse lisada. Aga
sellega kõik, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
